svg.title: How a security report is handled
svg.desc: A vulnerability is reported privately through the GitHub Security tab, or by email to admin at brockcsc dot ca. A co-president triages it within days rather than hours. The fix lands on main, which is the only supported line, and merging installs the theme and restarts Keycloak so it is live within minutes. A GitHub advisory follows, with credit. Two panels list what is worth reporting in this repository — markup or CSS that changes what the login form submits, anything that covers or imitates a Keycloak-rendered field, anything that could carry credentials off the page, and dropping the parent theme chain — and what is not, including Keycloak and PatternFly themselves, layout bugs, realm configuration, and how the theme reaches the server.
svg.text: BRAND-THEMES · SECURITY
From a private report to a restarted Keycloak
This repository renders a login page. That is the whole reason it has a security policy.
HOW A REPORT TRAVELS
Report it privately
Security tab → Report a vulnerability. The thread stays private until there is a fix, so nothing is published early.
private reporting: enabled
admin@brockcsc.ca if that fails
A co-president reads it
Expect days rather than hours. Nobody is on call, term breaks are real, and the same few people run
everything else in the club — so you get an honest answer, not a fast one.
Fix on main
The supported version is whatever is installed on the realm right now. There are no releases to patch and
nothing to back-port, which is why this file has no version table.
Merging installs it, then we disclose
A merge to main runs the deploy workflow, so a reviewed fix is on the login page minutes later — including
the few seconds where sign-in is unavailable while Keycloak restarts to drop its theme cache.
A GitHub advisory follows, crediting you by whatever name you ask for — or by none.
SCOPE — WHAT THIS REPOSITORY IS
WORTH REPORTING HERE
Markup or CSS that changes what the login form
submits, or where it submits to
Anything that covers, hides or imitates a field
Keycloak rendered, or the provider button
A change that could carry a username, password
or an authentication code off the page
Dropping parent=keycloak.v2, so upstream fixes
stop reaching the login page
NOT IN SCOPE
Keycloak and PatternFly themselves — those go
upstream, not here
Contrast, spacing and layout bugs — real, but
ordinary issues, so please just file one
Realm settings, clients and password policy:
none of that lives in this repository
How the theme reaches the server, which is
operations rather than code in this repo
Code scanning, Dependabot alerts and secret scanning with push protection run on this repository, and main is protected.
Fork pull requests run scripts/validate.sh only — structure, no network, no secrets — so a PR can never reach the deploy key.
